name: admin-portal-agent
description: AI Agent specialized in building the T.O.O.L.S Inc Admin Portal with Shadcn UI components, DataTables, and case management features
capabilities: Shadcn UI component integration and customization
DataTable implementation with server-side filtering and pagination
Dashboard layout design with sidebar navigation
Case notes rich text editor (Tiptap integration)
Participant management UI with skills_tags filtering
Azure Static Web Apps routing configuration
Supabase RLS policy implementation for admin access

primary: Case notes editor with Tiptap rich text
Stat cards for KPIs (Active Participants, Job Placements, Pending Referrals)

technical_stack.frontend: Next.js 14 App Router with 'use client' components
technical_stack.ui_framework: Shadcn UI + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
technical_stack.backend: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security
technical_stack.auth: Supabase Auth with Azure AD OAuth (admin role required)

key_files.participant_detail: app/admin/participants/[id]/page.tsx - Individual participant view with case notes
key_files.helpers: lib/supabase.ts - Database helper functions already implemented

implementation_priorities.name: Admin Dashboard Layout
tasks: Create app/admin/layout.tsx with Shadcn Sidebar component
Implement navigation: Dashboard, Participants, Referrals, Programs, Reports
Add admin role check in layout with redirect to /portal/dashboard for non-admins
Create stat cards component for KPI display

implementation_priorities.name: Participants DataTable
tasks: Install Shadcn DataTable component with dependencies
Create columns definition with skills_tags renderer (badges)
Implement client-side filtering by name, status, skills
Add pagination with row selection
Create 'Add Participant' modal form
Link rows to participant detail pages

implementation_priorities.name: Participant Detail & Case Notes
tasks: Create dynamic route app/admin/participants/[id]/page.tsx
Fetch participant data with getCurrentProfile() and related enrollments
Install Tiptap editor with basic formatting (bold, italic, lists, links)
Create case notes component with save functionality
Add skills_tags editor with tag input component
Display AI consultation history from getParticipantConsultations()

implementation_priorities.name: Advanced Features
tasks: Implement referral management interface
Add bulk actions for participant status updates
Create export functionality (CSV) for participants list
Build analytics dashboard with Recharts integration

design_patterns.auth_check: Use useAuth() hook with admin role verification in useEffect
design_patterns.data_fetching: Server Components where possible, 'use client' only for interactive UI
design_patterns.forms: React Hook Form with Zod validation schemas
design_patterns.modals: Shadcn Dialog component for create/edit flows

supabase_helpers_available: createParticipant({ case_manager_id, first_name, last_name, status, skills_tags })
notes: All admin routes protected by middleware.ts - checks admin role from profiles table
Use existing helper functions from lib/supabase.ts - no need to write raw queries
Follow existing design system from tailwind.config.ts (dark theme tokens)
Match UI patterns from app/portal/ pages for consistency
Skills tags should be clickable to filter participants by that skill
Case notes should auto-save drafts every 30 seconds
Display participant's AI consultation count in DataTable as sortable column
